text: Complete your preparation sheets as follows. The amounts you cook should be sufficient for two
or three people. You may use recipe books.
At the end of the planning session, give your question paper, preparation sheets and any notes
you have made to the Supervisor. You may not take these away from the planning session. You
may not bring any additional notes to the practical test.

parts.text:
Make a hot savoury dish and make a batch of scones.
2 (a) Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal that is high in iron and vitamin C.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a dish using shortcrust pastry and make a batch of small cakes.
3 Prepare, cook and serve five skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different main ingredient
from the following list:
cheese, citrus fruit, ground (minced) beef, lentils, oats, rice, yeast.

text: At the beginning of the practical test, you will be given back your question paper, preparation
sheets and any notes you made during the planning session.
For the purposes of the Practical Test, a balanced main meal must consist of:
TWO skilful dishes plus a minimum of TWO suitable accompaniments.
1 (a) Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes for two 10-year-olds to take to school as a cold
packed meal to be eaten without cutlery. Two of the dishes must be savoury.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two office workers.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a cake using the whisking method and make a batch of savoury muffins.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve four skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different cooking
method from the following list:
boiling, grilling, pressure cooking, shallow frying, steaming.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve a balanced main meal for two elderly relatives.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make a dish using a pouring batter and make a cake using the creaming method.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes using the hob and/or the grill of the cooker only.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Make one savoury dish and one sweet dish, both of which should be baked in the oven.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Prepare, cook and serve three skilful dishes, each showing the use of a different vegetable
as a main ingredient.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Make a cold dessert using fruit and make a batch of biscuits using the melting method.
